text:
Daniel (Onboarding): Starting Anchorage Retail onboarding thread. Goal: pilot live in 28 days, customer-facing pilot for a single storefront. Need to lock stakeholders, success metrics, and any blockers. 30m kickoff today or tomorrow?

Rita (CSM): I can do tomorrow 11am PT. I'll lead the weekly health tracker and customer comms.

Jon (Solutions Eng): Tomorrow 11am PT ok. Need to confirm whether Anchorage requires IP allowlist, VPC peering, or private deployment for PII workloads.

Taylor - Anchorage (Customer): 11am works. We do handle PII but only in tokenized form, prefer VPC peering. Can start in hosted sandbox if peering takes longer.

Daniel (Onboarding): Draft success metrics for kickoff: 1) sandbox integration + successful end-to-end flow; 2) 99% availability during load test window; 3) 95th pct latency <400ms on 256-token typical requests; 4) acceptance pass on 8k labeled prompts; 5) recorded enablement session + runbook published.

Maya (Renewals): Add baseline engagement target (30-day DAU) and cost-watch flag. Customer mentioned procurement review at month end  mark as "procurement_watch".

Priya (Enablement): I'll prepare a one-pager + 30-min recorded walkthrough and a cheat-sheet for common errors. Recommend a live training at day 5 after integration.

Jon (Solutions Eng): Tech starter checklist Ill bring: API key creation, CORS/allowlist, model selection (we recommend redwood/opt-serial-7b for early pilot), example payloads, smoke test curl:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" -d '{"model":"redwood/test-small","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"sample"}]}'
```

Daniel (Onboarding): @calendar-bot please create 30m kickoff tomorrow 14:00 ET / 11:00 PT. Agenda: intros, confirm success metrics, infra requirements, timelines & owners, enablement schedule.

calendar-bot: Event "Anchorage Retail 1 Onboarding Kickoff" scheduled for 2026-05-03 14:00 ET. Invitees: Daniel, Rita, Jon, Taylor, Priya, Maya.

Taylor - Anchorage (Customer): I'll share infra POC and a gzipped dump of prompts (~8k) before the meeting. Also note: security requires SOC2 documentation for private deployments.

Maya (Renewals): Noting SOC2 requirement  could lengthen private deploy timeline. Ill flag procurement_watch and assign renewal buddy.

Rita (CSM): Actions recap: Taylor to share POC + prompts (before kickoff); Jon to post tech checklist + stress test template (1 day post-kickoff); Priya to deliver enablement pack (day 5); Daniel to share owner tracker after kickoff; Maya to add procurement_watch in CRM.

Taylor - Anchorage (Customer): Confirming we can start in hosted sandbox and plan peering later. Will share timelines.

Daniel (Onboarding): Great  I'll run the kickoff and circulate notes + owners. Thanks team :rocket:

Rita (CSM): Thanks all.

Jon (Solutions Eng): See you at kickoff.

Priya (Enablement): Will prepare slides and quickstart link.
